描述_EN: the filter-like part of the cigarette is replaceable and contains the nicotine liquid; the white part contains the battery, recharged by screwing on to a usb attachment. vype brand e-cigarettes are designed and manufactured by cn creative, a division of british american tobacco. since then demand for e-cigarettes has grown exponentially and in 2014 global sales are expected to reach £4 billion. first patented in 1963, the basic design for today’s e-cigarettes was pioneered by chinese pharmacist hon lik, who began manufacturing and exporting his own version in 2003. an electronic cigarette is a battery-powered device that heats and vaporises a liquid containing nicotine to give the sensation of smoking a cigarette but without tobacco. currently, they are marketed both as smoking cessation aids and as a glamorous new consumer product that circumvents smoking bans. there is currently no regulation of the manufacture, sale and promotion of e-cigarettes but their popularity is prompting regulators to take notice. their design closely resembles a traditional cigarette, both in appearance and sensation, with a rubberised coating that attempts to recreate the feel of cigarette paper. british american tobacco was the first of the large established tobacco firms to enter the uk e-cigarette market in 2013. an advertisement for vype aired nearly 50 years after tobacco advertising was banned on british television.

Vype牌电子烟是由英美烟草公司旗下的cn创意公司设计和制造的。 此后，对电子烟的需求成倍增长，2014年全球销售额预计将达到40亿英镑。 第一次获得专利是在1963年，今天的电子烟的基本设计是由中国药剂师韩立开创的，他在2003年开始制造和出口自己的版本。 电子香烟是一种以电池为动力的设备，它加热并蒸发含有尼古丁的液体，给人以吸烟的感觉，但没有烟草。 目前，它们既被作为戒烟辅助工具，又被作为规避吸烟禁令的迷人的新消费品进行销售。 目前没有对电子烟的制造、销售和推广进行监管，但它们的流行正促使监管者注意到。 它们的设计在外观和感觉上都与传统香烟非常相似，有一层橡胶涂层，试图重现香烟纸的感觉。 英美烟草公司是第一个在2013年进入英国电子烟市场的大型烟草公司。 在英国电视上禁止烟草广告近50年后，Vype的广告才播出。
